title: Extend, do not replace
description:
`Greeter::greet` returns `"Hello, <name>"`. Write `ExcitedGreeter`, derived from `Greeter`, whose own `greet` produces the base class's greeting with `"!!!"` added.

Call the base version from inside yours with `Greeter::greet(name)`. Do not copy its code: if the base greeting ever changes, yours should follow.
